name: OpenTelemetry Certified Associate

exam.format: Online proctored multiple-choice exam, 90 minutes; no formal prerequisites listed, two-year validity and a retake listed.

scope: Observability fundamentals, API/SDK, Collector and maintaining/debugging telemetry pipelines. This is an adjacent engineering credential, not an AI exam.
ai_policy: Check the current exam resource rules; preparation includes unaided instrumentation and troubleshooting.
